summary: The No Lyrics toggle only muted the vocals of the song playing at that moment. Every new song (next track, skip, streamer-mode change) started with vocals back on, and this only happened in builds because the editor re-applies the setting every frame. The fix makes the music system keep the vocal (and volume) setting for every track the playlist starts. In the editor, with the editor-only re-apply turned off, muted lyrics stayed at vocal 0 on a skipped track and after a streamer-mode restart, and un-muting brought vocals back on the current and next track; console had no errors. The result is inconclusive only because the check is on audio values - there is nothing visual to screenshot and the cloud machine has no sound output, so nobody has listened to it yet.
